name: Red-Team Scam - AnyDesk Remote Access Coercion (English)

caller_script.text: This is State Electricity Board technical department. Your digital smart meter has failed its safety update.
Your house electric supply will be automatically disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM if the update fails.
Open your mobile phone right now, go to the Play Store, and install AnyDesk or TeamViewer QuickSupport so our engineer can connect.
Once installed, read me the 9-digit remote access code from the screen so we can update your power connection!
